newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Miners lead Australian stocks higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Miners lead Australian stocks higher at open.

text.p: Australian shares opened higher on Thursday, the major miners leading the way up as base and precious metals prices remained firm in overseas markets.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index climbed 9.6 points to 2,356.5.
Brokers said the resource leaders had shown the way to the broader market although the industrials sector remained weighed down by a continuing weak News Corp share price.
News Corp shares have slipped since a disappointing first quarter profit on Tuesday which resulted in broker downgrades.
"Base metals and precious metals prices continued to be firm last night and that is helping our resource stocks and precious metals stocks," said Nevitts Ltd dealer Steve Mayne.
"There was a bit of a rally there yesterday and it's continued on today. The industrials are still being weighed down by News Corp."
Turnover and activity levels were only moderate.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about five to two, while about 43 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
